label: Simple priority is transitive, from transitive dependence and the priority bridges
description: If x is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to y and y to z, the requirement bridge gives y depending on x, z on y and the two reverse non-dependences; transitivity gives z depending on x, and if x depended on z then x would depend on y, contrary to the first priority; the sufficiency bridge then makes x prior to z. Neither reflexivity nor nonmutuality of D is used. All three premises are about the same D as DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING defines it; no closure or other reading enters. A conditional support option for the bare root-route premise; all three premises remain open, and the order-law controls show transitivity of D cannot be dropped.
